# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.3

Guarded, repeatable Windows production deployment.

Highlights:

- packages one PowerShell orchestrator for preflight, online database-copy
  rehearsal, optional port-3100 acceptance, final cutover, status, and rollback;
- verifies `server.exe` and `rx-db.exe` against the official release checksums;
- copies the existing production `.env` and changes only the isolated NEXT
  database name;
- automatically discovers PostgreSQL Windows client tools, including the
  production PostgreSQL 18 installation;
- creates PostgreSQL custom-format backups plus SHA-256 sidecars;
- requires exact confirmations and a successful same-release rehearsal before
  it can stop or redirect the production service;
- retains the unchanged RX Tracker 3.3.1 application/database as the immediate
  acceptance-window fallback.

This release does not change the RX Tracker UI, business behavior, or RX
Softphone. Extract it into `C:\RX-Tracker\RX-APP-NEXT` beside the existing
`RX-APP` folder and follow `docs/database/CUTOVER_AND_ROLLBACK.md`. Start with
`scripts\Invoke-NextProduction.ps1 -Action Preflight`; that action makes no
database or Windows-service changes.
